title: STARPORT
description: A Simple Vanilla+ Modpack focused on making a more animated social experience. This modpack focuses on using resource packs and QOL mods to make Minecraft feel more dynamic and Cinematic.

![A Minecraft-Like Logo that says Starport](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3ae203c41acc80f497f941f64859f9c8550af8f.png)

# Welcome to the STARPORT Modpack

## Introduction
The STARPORT Modpack is a Vanilla+ Modpack focused on creating a more animated & dynamic experience, while not introducing anything overly complex to Minecraft. Several new features allow for a great time, whether you're playing solo or with your Friends.

_Multiplayer is Recommended_

## Main Changes
Numerous QOL features enhance the game's functionality and overall experience.

Some of the main features include
- Hold My Items - Animated First Person
- Fresh Animations + A bunch of Fresh Packs: Animated 3rd Person, Mobs, and 3D Items
- Blur & Smooth UI: A few mods to smooth out and polish the UI
- Shoulder Surfing Reloaded: A new way to experience 3rd Person in Minecraft.
- Sound Physics + Footsteps + Ambient Sounds: Sound mods that fill in the silence.
- A bunch of Particle Mods: Makes the game feel more alive and dynamic

There are a few social features that have been added
- Voice Chat + Sound Physics: Talk to your friends, either in Proximity chat or in Groups. Experience Reverb in Caves, and make sure you whisper around Shulk Sensors.

- Chat Heads: You can now see your friends' heads inside the chat when they talk. This will help make the chat feel more modern and emotional.

- Lootr: All loot containers generated in structures are now client-side. If you have any friends who pillage villages, you can still go through and get your loot.

## Server Setup
1. Download the newest server pack
2. Take the mods and config
3. Download the Fabric Server
4. Port forward: ```25565``` and ```24454```
5. Then give your friends the IP. 
6. Make sure you whitelist it (Just for safety)!


## Thank you
I really wanted to make something for my friends and family, but making this public will allow other people to enjoy what I have been working on. I know it isn't much, but I hope you enjoy it.

_**XNDR (STARPORT STUDIOS)**_
